properties.name: hxm_program's hub feedback becomes phase 7: a hub on one machine
properties.rationale:
Anthony 2026-10-21: "Go with (b) Only when asked, with \"merge\" in the call" (dec:import-merges-or-demands-whole-nodes accepted) and "Go with recommendations. This seems like a fair amount of work, so maybe start another reflow2 epoch/increment to capture this work."
GROUNDWORK (read-and-measure only, published 0.89.0 binary on throwaway stores, code at origin/main f3e85e7cd): item 5's root cause is recorded on req:an-import-says-what-it-removed-and-merges-only-when-asked (candidates: deliberate whole-node replace, CONFIRMED by design; the promised partial-node refusal only checks required properties, CONFIRMED, the defect; the adopt skill steering bulk work to import, CONFIRMED in the text, not shown to be what hxm's agent read; a version difference, REFUTED; export checksum elision, not necessary). Items 1, 2 and 4 are accepted intent never built rather than defects against a built promise; the one small defect inside item 1 is that a local hub's search names no unsearched pinned design, which the accepted requirement forbids. The stale 2026-09-28 claim on cap:search-design-reaches-the-designs-a-hub-tracks (branch feat/one-search-reaches-every-tracked-design, never pushed) was released.
RECOMMENDATIONS TAKEN: exact evidence only for computed seams (dec:two-designs-are-linked-on-exact-evidence-and-a-similar-name-is-only-a-candidate); item 7 left proposed because once tracked search reads exports, reads no longer need store paths, writes already work through .reflow2.toml, and a per-machine list goes stale. The decision's old counter-argument about held-store search was fixed in 0.78.0. Look again after phase 7's step 2.
The reasoning build list (epoch:planned-reasoning-build-list) is NOT concluded: flo2's phase 6 half waits on flo2 #174, step 6 (the capstone demo) is still planned, and Chris's stage-5 re-read waits on his answers. Phase 7 runs before step 6. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq

properties.summary: hxm_program's 2026-10-20 hub feedback (7 items) was root-caused and triaged on Anthony's word: one defect (import_graph silently replaces partial nodes) and six ideas. Kept as intent and scheduled in the new epoch:planned-p7-a-hub-on-one-machine: the import fix, local tracked-design search (the accepted req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks), N-way composition, computed seams on exact evidence, a link into a pinned design that says when its record is gone, and each member's reviewed revision in upstream_status. Considered, not kept: a per-machine address book of member stores. Phase 6 (epoch:planned-p6-argument-gaps) marked arrived: all 22 requirements shipped in v0.90.0.
